messages:
hannah: mini idea for Friday  'winter warmth micro-charm exchange'  make or repurpose a tiny token (mug sticker, mini jar of cocoa mix, knitted thumb-warmer, etc.) and leave it on the community shelf with a 1-line note. low effort, high smiles. :sparkles: :mug:

omar: yes! love tiny trades. can i donate 10 packets of instant hot cocoa as 'mystery sachets'? :hot_beverage: 

liz: count me in. quick Q: do we want an anonymous option? sometimes i want to drop a cheer without signing. :smile:

ben: anonymous would be sweet. also can we add an 'ugly-mug' poll as a bonus? winner gets the honorary 'mug of shame' for a week. :trophy: :mug_with_tea:

tara: omg the mug of shame. i'm so there. remote folks ok? i'm in boston and happy with a photo swap or mailed mini. 

hannah: remote totally welcome. small rules: 1) token size < 15cm, 2) optional note (1 line), 3) label if edible and avoid nuts. drop-off Fri 11:30 for in-office; remote DM me for mail help. i'll make a tiny sign-up sheet.

gloria-bot: Poll created: "Ugly Mug People's Choice" (ends in 24h). 

olmar: (typo) omar meant to say: i'll donate mini sachets AND a handful of cinnamon sticks for garnish. ; )

liz: i'll submit a knitted thumb-warmer. warning: very tiny, slightly lopsided. :blush:

ben: does anyone want to run a tiny 'photo gallery' board? i'll take pics and post them in the channel after 12. remote winners will get digital badges. 

hannah: ben you are MVP. i'll make two stacks: 'take one' and 'leave one' on the shelf. anonymous slips will be a little box next to them. 

tara: pro-tip: if mailing small jars, use bubble tape + label 'fragile'. also include a paper towel inside. learned the hard way. :sweat_smile:

olmar: submitted: 'ben_uglymug1.jpg' (you've been warned) :joy: 

gloria-bot: Reminder: "Winter Warmth Micro-Charm drop-off" Fri 11:30 (channel: #random). 

hannah: thanks everyone! i'll post the sign-up link in 10m and pin a photo of the shelf layout for clarity. tiny cheer energy = big vibes. :heart:
